prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] pick_friend_habitat_preview_new_screen: Adds a new habitat selection screen right after pick_friend allowing users to select a desktop background theme for their companion.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Select your pet and explore its desktop environment"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_habitat_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_habitat_preview": {"headline": "Choose Desktop Habitat", "body": "Select where your desktop pet will spend its time on your screen.", "layout": "grid"}}
1: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_protection_reassurance: Adds a explicit hint on sign_in clarifying that signing in backs up pets permanently to prevent progress loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your account keeps your desktop pet saved permanently across device sessions."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_sound_preview_redesign: Redesigns pick_friend into a spotlight layout featuring interactive audio sound previews for each pet choice.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Listen to pet sound", "action": "play"}]}}
3: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_journey_preview_card: Adds a quick-start duration hint on choose_path letting users know setup takes less than two minutes.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Quick setup takes less than 2 minutes to bring your companion to life."}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] upload_photos_style_preset_new_screen: Inserts a new screen for choosing rendering style presets when creating or custom-styling a pet photo.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_style_presets", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_style_presets": {"headline": "Select Render Style", "body": "Pick your favorite visual style for desktop pet generation.", "layout": "card"}}
5: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_placement_preview: Shows a live visual placement preview of where the pet will anchor on the screen while waiting for adoption processing.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Preparing pet placement on your taskbar and desktop workspace...", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] story_mascot_intro_redesign: Redesigns the initial story welcome into a stage layout with a greeting mascot introducing the app concept.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Hi! Let's get your new desktop pet set up."}]}}
7: [finish, hint] home_intro_dock_visibility_hint: Adds explicit instructions on home_intro showing how to locate and toggle pet controls from the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Look for the pet icon in your system tray to show, hide, or interact with your pet anytime."}}
8: [adoption, new_flow] adoption_certificate_signature_new_flow: Replaces the static adoption certificate block with an interactive companion oath checklist before completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"replace": {"certificate": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "I promise to feed and interact with my desktop companion", "role": "certificate"}]}}}
9: [sign_in, incentive] sign_in_social_quick_auth_incentive: Adds an cloud backup badge on sign_in highlighting instant cross-device account protection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Instant Cloud Protection Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a valid new habitat preview screen within onboarding without skipping required steps or changing functionality outside onboarding.
Adds an explanatory hint to sign-in regarding cloud backup without violating any rules.
Redesigns pick_friend with sound previews while maintaining the screen's core job of choosing a pet.
Adds a setup duration hint on choose_path without violating any guidelines.
Adds a new style presets screen inside onboarding while keeping all required steps.
Enhances the waiting screen with a visual placement preview while maintaining its job of showing pet creation.
Redesigns the story intro layout with a mascot while continuing to introduce the pet/app concept.
Adds a helpful dock visibility hint to the home intro overlay.
Replaces the certificate block with a checklist, losing the required official stamp and adoption certificate display.
Adds a sign-in account protection badge without introducing unfair design patterns or altering pricing.
